name: Emera Incorporated Preferred Shares (EMA.PR.C)
summary: Emera Incorporated is a diversified energy and utility business generating, transmitting and distributing electricity through its subsidiaries in Florida, Canada and elsewhere, along with gas utilities and infrastructure. Its generation mix includes coal, natural gas, oil, hydro, wind, solar, petroleum coke and biomass, and it also procures, transports and sells natural gas.
